title: pvp General pack
description: This resource pack is designed for fans of combat in Minecraft (PvP).
body:
The first resource pack made by an Arab!

This resource pack is designed for fans of combat in Minecraft (PvP).

Features of the resource pack:
**1- Changes the aiming indicator             
2- Speeds up crystal explosions because they don't contain bubbles            
3- Changes the sword's shape and makes it smaller          
4- Changes the totem so that when it explodes, it doesn't obstruct the screen          
5- Hides fire from the screen so it doesn't obstruct the screen when it burns       
6- boost fps       **

I hope you have a great experience with this pack, and don't forget to rate it, as this is the first version I've released.

Note: This pack is inspired by the Apex resource pack and the Marlowe resource pack, and I've modified them.
